options.content: **Live CAN3 · 1-second refresh.** Battery, coolant temperature, G forces, steering and suspension use dash-comparison conversions. Pressure, oil temperature, lambda, throttle and wheel-speed readings use **provisional raw ÷ 10**, as agreed; adjust after reference checks. RPM, fuel level and yaw remain labeled raw pending scaling. Gear 0 = N. G-force graph range: 0–3 G. Original raw readings remain stored in InfluxDB; latest cards expire after 5 seconds. Fuel pressure now uses provisional raw ÷ 100.

panels.title: Battery Volts · 0x001
panels.description: 1293 counts versus approximately 12.9 V on dash. Original raw data is retained in InfluxDB. Sensor note: ; dash note: 12.9

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "can3_raw" and r.can_id == "1" and r.source == "${source}" and r._field == "unsigned_be")
  |> group(columns: ["channel", "session", "device", "_field"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value) * 0.01}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: true)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
